# NAMODOT
> Next-generation Enterprise IT Solutions, Educational ERP, Healthcare Platforms, and Global Shipment Tracking Intelligence.

## About
NAMODOT is a modern technology and AI solutions organisation delivering cutting-edge digital enterprise software. Based in Trichy, Tamil Nadu, India, NAMODOT builds scalable web applications, enterprise management platforms, and logistics tracking architectures.

## Flagship Products
- **Namo Shipcart**: Global export-import cargo and container tracking platform with real-time multi-carrier telemetry, automated customs documentation, and port milestone alerts.
- **Namo CampusOne**: All-in-one ERP system digitalizing university and higher education campus administrative and academic lifecycles.
- **Namo School**: School management system automating attendance, fee collections, timetables, examinations, and parent communications.
- **Namo Healthcare**: Digital healthcare ecosystem offering clinical management, electronic health records, patient care workflows, and medical telemetry.
- **Namo HrSuite**: Complete workforce management platform simplifying corporate payroll, shift attendance, talent acquisition, and performance reviews.
